Term1: Haemophilus influenza Type B vaccine information
Text:
## Vaccine route, orders, names
## __________________________
## Route: IM
## Outpatient Hib orders:
[One dose](orz-set-abx-op-haemophilus-b-vaccine-one-dose)
HSCT Pts only:
[3 dose series](orz-set-abx-op-haemophilus-b-vaccine-3-dose-series)
## CPRS name:
HAEMOPHILUS B VACCINE
INJ,LYPHL
## Stocked brand name:
Hiberix
## Other names:
Haemophilus influenzae
type b
(Hib)
References:
Immunization Action
Coalition,
Summary of Adult
Immunizations, 2021, P2011
Freedman et al., Annals of
internal medicine, 2021,
174(3)374-384.
<!-- COLUMN 2 -->
## Recommended populations
## __________________________
*Not routinely recommended
for healthy adults.
*Those adults at highest
risk of serious Hib
disease include people who
1) have anatomic or
functional asplenia,
2) are undergoing an
elective splenectomy, or
3) are recipients of
hematopoietic stem cell
transplant (HSCT).
<!-- COLUMN 3 -->
## Administration Schedule
## __________________________
*Give 1 dose to adults in
categories 1 or 2 (see 2nd
bullet in column to left)
if no history of previous
Hib vaccine.
*For HSCT patients,
regardless of Hib vacci-
nation history, give 3
doses, at least 4wks
apart, beginning 6-12
months after transplant.
<!-- COLUMN 4 -->
## Contraindications/Precautions
## __________________________
## Contraindications:
History of severe allergic
reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to a previous
dose or a vaccine
component.
## Precautions:
Moderate or severe acute
illness with or
without fever.
